capabilities: Create and open .excalidraw drawings from the command palette or ribbon
Draw with the bundled official Excalidraw editor
Autosave drawings and embed pasted images as data
Preview and embed drawings in notes
extras: Deliberately omits OCR, AI, collaboration, cloud sync, a drawing library, accounts and export workflows; release main.js is kept under 5 MB for Obsidian Sync Standard; MIT licensed; optional custom handwriting font set by vault-relative path.
intentEvidence: The excellent Obsidian Excalidraw plugin by zsviczian offers extensive integrations and a large feature set
motivation: The author wanted to bring Excalidraw's immediate, hands-on drawing experience to an offline vault without turning it into another complex workspace.
problem: Drawing in Obsidian usually means adopting a large, integration-heavy Excalidraw setup rather than a plain offline canvas.

relations.evidence: The excellent Obsidian Excalidraw plugin by zsviczian offers extensive integrations and a large feature set
If you need the advanced features this plugin intentionally leaves out, Excalidraw+ is the better fit
Uses the official Excalidraw editor with its standard drawing tools.

summary: Local-first Excalidraw editor that creates, opens and autosaves portable .excalidraw JSON drawings inside the vault.
